outcome.answer: Shutong Qiao is a coauthor of VaLiDRec, which proposes variable-length, LLM-aligned semantic IDs for generative recommendation [1]. It builds IDs from informative native LLM tokens, adapting their length to item semantic complexity, and predicts token sets rather than generating IDs autoregressively [1]. Qiao also coauthored an empirical study of OCR-based text representations for semantic ID learning, but that paper does not focus on variable-length IDs [8].
